ci.scope: Verification commit adds only the four listed .github evidence/workflow files; the candidate is checked out separately at the clean product-code commit.

normalization.operation: Exact literal UTF-8 prefix replacement only
normalization.unchanged: All other bytes, including whitespace, ANSI escapes, errors, stderr, timestamps, ports, and JSON formatting, are retained.

preservation: raw-go-evidence.json stores each normalized source file as a string. JSON container escaping changes only its representation, not the decoded file bytes. Original and normalized SHA-256 hashes are computed before container serialization.
privacy: No transient artifact-download URL, access token, or signed download credential is included. The raw records contain loopback/test URLs and public documentation/module URLs.
